art.title: PBA 2025-2026 Articulation Agreement Manual (admission requirements, English proficiency)

test_policy.notes: Admission is test optional; SAT, ACT or CLT scores are considered if sent. The international page says freshmen's scores are not required but may be sent for bonus scholarships. PBA reserves the right to request a score, and some scholarships (Honors, Farish) need one.

requirements.notes: Apply on PBA's own application or the Common App (the international page calls the application free). Official high school transcript, with an official NACES course-by-course evaluation for non-U.S. schools. Decisions come in about 72 hours after the application is complete. A $300 enrollment deposit is needed before International Student Services issues the I-20.

deadlines.label: Rolling admission (fall 2027 entry); no application deadline published
deadlines.notes: PBA begins reviewing applications each September on a rolling basis. No international-specific or final application deadline is printed on the freshman or international pages. Class selection and housing are first come, first served by deposit date.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for students from a country where English is not the primary language. Waived for students who have attended a U.S. school, an English language school, or a non-U.S. school taught in English for at least one academic semester. No conditional admission or ESL pathway is described on the pages read.

english.notes: From the 2025-26 Articulation Manual (freshmen). The international page names TOEFL, IELTS or Duolingo but prints no scores.
Freshman minimum is 100 in the manual; the same manual lists 105 in the transfer section, so confirm with admissions.

cost.notes: Full-time day undergraduate tuition $21,500 per semester ($43,000 per year, 12-18 credits). General fees for full-time students and room and board are not printed on the tuition page, so they are left null. College Navigator lists 2024-25 food and housing of $13,800 on campus.

aid.notes: The international page says international students are eligible for many scholarships and aid but gives no amounts; the scholarships page lists none specific to international students. Freshman awards: Academic Merit (amount varies by GPA), Honors $2,500/yr (3.5 weighted GPA plus SAT 1270 or ACT 26), Farish Scholars (full tuition and fees; 3.5 GPA plus SAT 1330 or ACT 29 or CLT 89, interview). Federal aid requires U.S. citizenship or eligible noncitizen status.

toefl.note: No TOEFL institution code is printed on the pages read; results must be sent directly by the testing service.
